body: anybody else experience this?
Even I observe the same issue.
It appears that the bk- prefix is dropped on the click interaction, so that the css selectors don't match up. before: after:
I get the same error.
I too have the same issue :(
Can someone post a complete minimal example that can be run to investigate this?
@bryevdv I can gladly make one. I am traveling for a bit, and if no one has knocked this out on my return, I'll post one.

@jbrambleDC I went ahead and made one:

```
from bokeh.models import DatePicker, HBox
from bokeh.io import curdoc

from datetime import datetime

beginning = DatePicker(title="Begin Date", min_date=datetime(2014,11,1),
                       max_date=datetime.now(),
                       value=datetime(datetime.now().year,1,1))

def cb(attr, old, new):
  print(new)

beginning.on_change('value', cb)

curdoc().add_root(HBox(children=[beginning]))
```

A pretty trivial change gets things working:

```
diff --git a/bokehjs/src/coffee/models/widgets/date_picker.coffee b/bokehjs/src/coffee/models/widgets/date_picker.coffee
index c5aab64..7b620d6 100644
--- a/bokehjs/src/coffee/models/widgets/date_picker.coffee
+++ b/bokehjs/src/coffee/models/widgets/date_picker.coffee
@@ -25,7 +25,8 @@ class DatePickerView extends BokehView
     return @

   onSelect: (dateText, ui) =>
-    @mset('value', new Date(dateText))
+    d = new Date(dateText)
+    @mset('value', d.toString())
     @mget('callback')?.execute(@model)

 class DatePicker extends InputWidget.Model
```

However, I still see the CSS styling disappear, and about that I have no idea. `render` is only getting called once, so it's a mystery. Any ideas @brendancol ?

OK here's another diff that I think would be a pretty great improvement, it attaches the date picker to an input and only pops up the dialog when the input is interacted with: ``` diff --git a/bokehjs/src/coffee/models/widgets/date_picker.coffee b/bokehjs/src/coffee/models/widgets/date_picker.coffee index c5aab64..788eb56 100644 --- a/bokehjs/src/coffee/models/widgets/date_picker.coffee +++ b/bokehjs/src/coffee/models/widgets/date_picker.coffee @@ -15,17 +15,19 @@ class DatePickerView extends BokehView render: () -> @$el.empty() $label = $('

I believe that the source of the styling issue is because of the date picker initialization.

We went through a process of prefixing everything bokeh with bk- 

That means that the css in our widgets css is, for example bk-ui-widget-header.

I see a brief flash of the correct styling and then no styling. I believe what's happening is that we load it with the correct styling but then the js that drives the datepicker reverts the css classes to not having a bk- prefix.

HTH

@bryevdv  Sir, is my code expected to work if i go ahead and make those changes in the coffee script or is there any other compiling process process for changes to reflect within bokeh functionality? I tried running the same example code of yours with the changes to the date_picker.coffee script, but i got the same error of `expected a date, string or timestamp, got {}`

@savadhani The CoffeeScript has to be compiled to JavaScript. Then you have to make sure to use the local resources you built, instead of the released version of BokehJS from CDN. There's instructions for all of that in the developer guide, but the diffs above were really provided for the benefit of anyone who would like to help fix the issue, rather than something that would be easily useful to general users. 

@birdsarah I suspected something like that, but I have no idea how to fix. Any ideas?
Oh alright!  Thanks a lot @bryevdv.  May I know when Bokeh update is going to be released?
As an experiment I tried putting the date picker div in a `bk-root` div by hand and it just made the date picker disappear
yeah I think it is just a css prefix issue.  I'm experimenting now with calling build_views on the datepicker element
copying the div into the existing `bk-root` makes it permanently show up, but also without styling
I'll also add that adding the `bk-` prefix to all the divs and classes the date picker creates, by hand in the browser, has no effect.
@birdsarah Ah ok thanks.
@birdsarah hey any luck with this one?  I can help test after you look into it.

Ok, I made #4489 which at least makes things work with an input that shows the selected date, and also has the date correctly available to a server callback. The date picker is still not styled, but we should merge this before `0.12` regardless.
@jbrambleDC just  heads up what will probably happen for `0.12` is that #4489 gets merged as-is. That will provide a functioning, but not well-styled date picker.
Should we close this issue post merge and then make a new issue for styling? or leave open? @bryevdv
